## Description {#details}

<p><a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/fileremover">FileRemover</a> - This class is a simple object meant to be stack allocated.</p>


<p>If an exception is thrown from a region, the object removes the filename specified (if deleteIt is true).</p>


<p>Definition at line 42 of file <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/files/include/include/llvm/include/llvm/support/fileutilities-h">FileUtilities.h</a>.</p>
